text_block_list.text:
The stage where cherry blossoms dance in 
the wind: the Oka Sho.

The Vodka of the past, who once threw 
herself into races with a do-or-die 
abandon, is no longer here.

Prepared to "win" no matter the race, 
Vodka headed into the first round of the 
Classic series against her destined 
rival... Daiwa Scarlet.
